model_license: Model weights were acquired privately and are not redistributed. The retained model card has an Apache front-matter versus MIT body/SPDX discrepancy, separate from the model zoo repository and runtime library licenses.

original_loader_failure.stage: automatic required-CUDA session initialization after official vendor-wheel installation

application.input_kind: original geometric example digits, not an accuracy dataset
application.contract: serial one-image calls, completed host outputs, no asynchronous GPU interface

placement.meaning: ORT operation placement from this run; event counts are not hardware counters or elapsed inference time

comparison.contract: prepared tensor, owned admission/input copy, completed host logits; PNG decode and normalization excluded equally
comparison.memory: not instrumented by this timing runner; separate process/device memory acceptance required
comparison.device_intervals: not supplied; host completed-call seconds are not kernel intervals
comparison.provider_placement: requires a separately retained actual operator profile for the executed provider

corrected_memory.scope: 64 serial completed eight-image requests, one owner and no overlapping requests. Separate from timing collection.
corrected_memory.device_scope: cudaMemGetInfo after context initialization reports shared-device OS free bytes, not this process's live allocations. Other applications can affect every sample.
corrected_memory.process_gpu_memory: unavailable through this probe. No process allocation bound or GPU leak verdict is established.
corrected_memory.deadline: 30-second cooperative decision limit includes initialization. Synchronous initialization and safe retirement are not forcibly interrupted, so this is not a hard process wall-time cap.
corrected_memory.host_scope: whole current-process working set, private commit and lifetime peaks. Imports, validator, loaded libraries and allocator caches are included.

installed_gpu_package_contracts.meaning: existing CPU and loader tests; required-CUDA rejection check skipped because this package includes CUDA

actual_required_cuda_contracts.meaning: full logits at0/1/2/8 images, ownership, host-gated queued/running cancellation and staleness, waiting close, host failure, closed session and finite identity history

fresh_cpu_only_contracts.meaning: Fresh CPU-only wheel installation, current source and explicit GPU cases skipped without opt-in

evidence_relabeling_fixtures.meaning: Metadata verification only: model,input,provider,setup/retirement,tolerance and memory summary tampering. No inference or device fault.

limitations: Shared workstation with ordinary user applications. No other task performance workload or named native game/profiler was observed when this unit started.
First invocation is separate and is not a cold-process sample.
ORT profiles supply operation placement, not device intervals or hardware counters.
Host gated cancellation is not interruption of an active GPU kernel.
Shared-device free memory and process totals do not isolate live allocations or prove a leak-free implementation.
ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM and WDDM sanitizer initialization remain separate unresolved diagnostics. Linux GPU and second-vendor execution were not performed.
